title: Computer-Aided Design and Drafting
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement in COMPUTER -AIDED DESIGN AND DRAFTING (CADD) TECHNICIAN with emphasis on employment preparation
outcomes: Compose advanced CADD 2-D drawings and identify computer concepts and terms including the CADD Draw, Modify, Layers, Annotation and Properties menus and utilize their functions and draw an accurate representation of a complex two-dimensional object at an advanced level (ILOs: Communication Skills, Critical Thinking Skills, Personal Development and Information Competency).

Identify the CADD Rendering and Animations menus and utilize their functions at a beginning level (ILOs: Communication Skills, Critical Thinking Skills, Ethics, Personal Development and Information Competency).
Compose basic CADD 3-D and GIS drawings and identify computer concepts and terms (ILOs: Communication Skills, Critical Thinking Skills, Personal Development and Information Competency).

Identify the various CADD and 3-D drawing and animation menus and utilize their functions (ILOs: Communication Skills, Critical Thinking Skills, Ethics, Personal Development and Information Competency).

Draw an accurate representation of a complex three- dimensional object and print an accurate representation of it on a 3-D Printer (ILOs: Communication Skills, Critical Thinking Skills, Ethics, Personal Development and Information Competency).

Conduct an effective job search in the CADD field and complete a professional application packet (ILOs: Communication Skills, Critical Thinking Skills, Ethics, Personal Development and Information Competency).

notes: Catalog prints codes with leading zeros (CADD 001-004); these match closed-list CADD 1-4, so not marked as catalog additions.
Outcome 5 breaks across lines as 'three- / dimensional'; recorded as 'three- dimensional' per the printed text; reviewer may confirm whether 'three-dimensional' was intended.

Careers taken from the description sentence saying CADD skills can be utilized by architects, engineers, landscapers, fabricators; it also names application areas '3-D printing' and 'Geographic Information Systems (GIS)' and employment 'in the CADD Industry', which were not recorded as careers.
